display.purpose: Venue names, screen titles, authored headlines.

board.purpose: Indicator-board labels: eyebrows, stop kind, status lines, button labels.

num.purpose: Every price, time, distance, headcount, reference/join code.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Ambient elevation on phone-frame chrome and raised surfaces; no hard offsets.

motion.name: board-flip
motion.purpose: Indicator-board flap flip on match/state change; reduces to 1ms under prefers-reduced-motion without removing the live-region announcement.

motion.name: rail-draw
motion.purpose: The route line drawing in on the match screen.

components.name: Plate — Action
components.description: Primary CTA field: orange fill, ink text, white/ink edge for AA boundary contrast.
components.css: .ds-plate { display:flex; min-height:44px; width:100%; align-items:center; gap:12px; border-radius:6px; padding:12px 16px; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 112, 'wght' 600; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; font-size:13px; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-plate-action { background:#e0652b; color:#1a1640; border:1px solid #ffffff; } .ds-plate-action:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-plate-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #edba40; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-plate-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Plate — Raised
components.description: Secondary row-style control on a raised ground surface.
components.html: <button class="ds-plate ds-plate-raised">Send to the group chat</button>
components.css: .ds-plate-raised { background:#453f95; color:#ffffff; border:none; border-radius:6px; min-height:44px; padding:12px 16px; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 112, 'wght' 600; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; font-size:13px; } .ds-plate-raised:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #edba40; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chip — Constraint Input
components.description: Tabular-figure constraint value; selection shown by fill, never colour alone.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:flex; min-height:44px; min-width:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:5px; border:1px solid; padding:8px 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 112,'wght' 700; letter-spacing:-0.02em; font-size:14px; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-chip-selected { border-color:#edba40; background:#edba40; color:#3b3686; } .ds-chip:not(.ds-chip-selected) { border-color:#b9b6e0; background:transparent; color:#b9b6e0; } .ds-chip:not(.ds-chip-selected):hover { color:#ffffff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #edba40; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Rail + RailNode
components.description: The route-line spine: a 3px vertical line with roundel stops (hollow/filled/ringed for open/locked/live). Decorative and aria-hidden; meaning is carried by the accompanying text, not the line alone.
components.css: .ds-rail-wrap { position:relative; height:120px; } .ds-rail { position:absolute; left:26px; top:0; bottom:0; width:3px; background:#e0652b; border-radius:2px; } .ds-node { position:absolute; left:27.5px; width:13px; height:13px; translate:-50% 0; border-radius:50%; border:3px solid #e0652b; background:#3b3686; box-sizing:content-box; } .ds-node-locked { background:#e0652b; }

components.html: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 190" role="img" aria-label="Map of the area around this venue" class="ds-maptile"><rect width="320" height="190" fill="#453f95"/><circle cx="148" cy="104" r="11" fill="#e0652b"/><circle cx="148" cy="104" r="4" fill="#3b3686"/></svg>

narrative.overview: Questly is Melbourne transit wayfinding applied to a night out: an orange route line runs down every list-shaped screen, roundel stops mark each item on it, and figures live on indicator-board plates that flip rather than fade. The system is dark-first by construction: `:root` carries the night palette as the base definition, and the day palette is layered on top under prefers-color-scheme and a data-theme override. Accessibility is structural: WCAG 2.2 AA governs every colour pairing, `--on-action` sits at exactly 4.9:1 on `--action` with no headroom, and a dedicated `--action-edge` token exists purely to satisfy the 3:1 non-text boundary requirement.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first tokens; day is the override, not the base
A vertical route line with roundel stops is the spine of list screens, not a grid
One variable font (Archivo) doing three jobs via axis + case, not three font families
Every quantity renders as a tabular figure — price, time, headcount, distance
Selection and boundary are never carried by colour alone

rules.name: The Accent Swaps, the Meaning Doesn't Rule
rules.body: --accent changes raw value by mode (apricot night, iris day) because the night colour fails contrast in daylight; the role always means 'this number/state matters'.

rules.name: The Fill-Only Orange Rule
rules.body: --action and --action-quiet are field colours; they never render as text colour in either mode.

rules.name: The Edge Carries the Boundary Rule
rules.body: --action-edge exists solely to give the CTA a 3:1 boundary since the orange fill alone measures 2.95–3.3:1 and --action cannot move.

rules.name: The Board-Is-Not-a-Kicker Rule
rules.body: The .board uppercase-label treatment is the world's indicator-board signage, used consistently for every short status/eyebrow/label string; it is the only small-caps label device in the system.

dos: Do treat :root as the dark/night definition and the light-mode blocks as the override.
Do use .board/.display/.num for their established jobs rather than arbitrary weight/tracking combinations.
Do render every price, time, distance, headcount, and reference/join code with .num tabular figures.
Do give every interactive control a 44x44px minimum target and a visible focus ring.
Do encode selection with fill and an ARIA state, never colour alone.
donts: Don't put opacity on text sitting over --action or --action-quiet.
Don't use --action or any orange-family colour as text/foreground ink in either mode.
Don't let --rail/periwinkle carry meaning by itself.
Don't use emoji or unicode glyphs as icons; use the drawn 24-box stroke set.
Don't lay out a list-like screen as a card grid.
